content.product_below_media_help: Child blocks added here move below the product media on desktop only.
content.app_required_for_ratings: An app is required for product ratings. [Learn more](https://help.shopify.com/manual/apps)
content.size_chart_custom: Use product metafield "foxtheme.size_chart" (type: page_reference) to show different size charts per product. [Add metafield](/admin/metafields/product)
content.product_compare_info_1: This allows comparison of product fields only, excluding variants.
content.product_compare_info_2: You can customize the product fields to compare by editing the blocks within the "Product compare" section.
content.compare_quick_table: Displays a quick comparison table for the current product and its dynamic recommendations
content.compare_table: Displays a comparison table for the products the customer has added to compare.
content.complementary_products: Shows products that pair well with the current product (e.g., phone case with phone). Configure complementary relationships in the Search & Discovery app. [Learn more](https://help.shopify.com/manual/online-store/search-and-discovery)
content.customer_account_paragraph: [Manage visibility](/admin/settings/customer_accounts) in customer account settings. Legacy accounts not supported.
content.heading: Heading
content.resource_reference_pickup_availability: Displays pickup availability from parent product
content.gift_card_form_description: Customers can send gift cards to a recipient's email with a personal message. [Learn more](https://help.shopify.com/manual/products/gift-card-products)
content.ends_time_1: Date format: YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM or YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM AA.
content.image_height_adapt: Image height adjusts automatically for optimal display.
content.name: Name
content.custom_field_content: Custom fields are used to collect customization information via your contact form.
content.collection_banner_condition: Fallback image — shown only when the collection has no banner metafield and no featured image.
content.top_bar_column_desktop_only: This column is visible on desktop only.
content.slideshow_height_auto: Slides height adapts to the first slide's media.

info.show_icon_labels: Adds text next to the header icons on desktop.
info.vertical_layout_only: Applies to the vertical layout only.
info.requires_parent_stretch: Only applies if the parent group's Position is set to Stretch.
info.image_hover_effect: How a card image responds to the pointer. Not affected by Scroll animations.
info.button_link: Color for plain text links (the "Button link" button style). Leave blank to inherit the text color.
info.column_order: Controls the display order of this column on mobile E.g: -9 to show first, 9 to show last.
info.enable_gift_wrap_per_product: When disabled, customers add one gift wrapping fee for the whole cart. When enabled, they can choose gift wrapping per product line in the cart (each line gets its own fee).
info.gift_wrap_sync_quantity: When enabled, gift wrap quantity matches the product quantity. When disabled, gift wrap quantity is always 1.
info.hide_separator_line_for_templates: Input each template name on a new line for which you want to hide the border. E.g.: index, page.contact, etc.
info.page_transitions_enabled: Fade between pages as the visitor navigates.
info.language_support_rtl: RTL languages will automatically switch to RTL layout based on the store's active language.
info.extra_weights: Enter additional font weights to load, separated by commas (e.g: 300, 400, 500)
info.animations_enabled: Reveal sections and blocks as they scroll into view. Hover and interface motion are not affected.
info.enable_preload_image: Preload the image if this section is visible on page load to help improve LCP.
info.custom_liquid: Add app snippets or other code to create advanced customizations. [Learn more](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid)
info.desktop_image_position: Position is automatically optimized for mobile.
info.cart_product_recommendations: Leave empty to show AI-powered recommendations based on cart items. Select specific products to display your own curated recommendations instead. [Learn more](https://help.shopify.com/manual/online-store/search-and-discovery/product-recommendations).
info.html_tag_info: Specify html code types for SEO and search engines for crawling purposes.
info.expand_filter_groups_info: Enter the filter groups to expand. Use a comma to separate values. Example: color,size,price
info.size_chart_title_info: Enter the option name (e.g: Size) where you want the size chart button to appear
info.free_shipping_goal_amount: Enter amount using number only. If using multiple currencies, separate each currency code with its amount (e.g: USD:100, EUR:95, JPY:13000)
info.enable_language_selector: To add a language, go to your [language settings.](/admin/settings/languages)
info.enable_country_selector: To add a country/region, go to your [market settings.](/admin/settings/markets)
info.enable_follow_on_shop: To allow customers to follow your store on the Shop app from your storefront, Shop Pay must be enabled. [Learn more](https://help.shopify.com/manual/online-store/themes/customizing-themes/follow-on-shop)
info.search_recommendation_keywords: Recommend most searched keywords in your store to customers. For example: t-shirt, dress, black
info.popup_trigger_open: "After scrolling" opens the popup once the visitor has scrolled roughly 700 pixels down the page. This works the same on desktop and on mobile.
info.column_separator: Drawn in the column gaps, between columns only — never on the outer edges.
info.separator_height: 0 = full grid height. Applies once across the whole grid, so a fixed height suits a single-row grid.
info.video_url: Use a YouTube or Vimeo URL
info.video_alt_text: Describe the video for assistive tech users
info.video_autoplay: Videos will be muted by default
info.collection_title: Leave blank to use the collection’s title.
info.collection_image: Leave blank to use the collection’s image.
info.collection_description: Leave blank to use the collection’s description.
info.custom_columns: Enter the number of columns for each breakpoint. Use a comma to separate values. Example: mb:1,md:2,lg:3,xl:4,xxl:5. [Read How-to](https://foxecom.link/TKJby8G)
info.promotions_width: Applies when menu item contains sub-items
info.list_tags: Each tag must be in its own line.
info.checkout_buttons: Allows buyers to check out faster and can improve conversion. [Learn more](https://help.shopify.com/manual/online-store/dynamic-checkout)
info.field_type: The phone field type can only be added once.
info.radio_options: Each option is separated by a comma (e.g: Option 1, Option 2, Option 3).
info.product_finder_collection: Drives the dropdown options (from this collection's storefront filters) and is the destination when the form is submitted. Configure the filters in Online Store → Search & Discovery.
info.product_finder_filter: The filter's name as shown on the collection page, e.g. Vehicle make or Brand (set up in Online Store → Search & Discovery). Advanced: its URL parameter also works (e.g. filter.p.m.custom.make).
info.icon_end: Displays an icon after the button label.
info.product_metafield: This uses the [Shopify metafield_tag filter](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/metafield_tag), which currently doesn't support list metafields other than a list of 'Single line text' values. Metaobjects are not currently supported.
info.maps_api_key: Required to show the map. Create a key in Google Cloud with the Maps Embed API enabled.
info.maps_map_query: A street address or lat,lng. An address shows a pin; coordinates center the map without one.
info.maps_intro: This block shows a Google map, which needs your own Google Maps API key. Paste it into the Map group below.
info.maps_location_name: Shown in the location dropdown. Add a Heading block below to show a title inside the card.
info.maps_card_gap: Space between the blocks inside a location's card. To open a wider gap before one block, give that block its own top padding.
info.maps_show_card: Turn this off to show the map on its own. The location dropdown sits inside the card, so with several locations the map stays on the first one.
info.carousel_controls_in_header: Controls sit in the title row, so the floating layouts are not available here.
info.content_animation_sequence: Each item in the list arrives after the one before it, instead of the whole list appearing at once.
info.countdown_number_text_transform: Digits have no letter case, so this only changes the unit labels below them (Days, Hours…), when those are shown.
info.show_separator_on_mobile: Lines are drawn only between columns, so a 1-column mobile layout never shows them regardless.
info.enable_parallax: Drifts the media as the section scrolls past. Follows the Scroll animations setting, and never runs for visitors who ask their device to reduce motion.
info.highlight_style: Wrap words in italics to highlight them — select text and click the "I" button in the editor.
info.finder_quiz_collection: Leave blank to use all products. Set up the filters in Online Store → Search & Discovery.
info.finder_quiz_option_source: Use filter values creates a text card for each value of the filter, in the order set in Search & Discovery.
info.finder_quiz_filter: Which store filter this question filters by. Manual cards set one of its values (e.g. Toyota); generated cards list them all.
info.finder_quiz_filter_value: The filter value this card selects, e.g. Toyota. Cards whose value matches no product are hidden.
info.recommendation_quiz_product_lists: Results show strong matches first, then partial matches, minus every excluded product.
info.product_quiz_question_gap: Space between the header and the options.
info.product_quiz_question_id: A short unique name, e.g. make. Used for [make] tokens in the results heading, for Skip questions on options, and in customer tags. Blank uses an internal ID, so tokens and skipping will not work for this question.
info.product_quiz_stepper_label: Used by the Stepper progress style. Leave blank to use the heading.
info.product_quiz_no_preference: This answer applies no filter and adds no products.
info.product_quiz_skip_questions: Question IDs to skip when this option is chosen, e.g. material, power. Only later questions are affected.
info.product_quiz_discount_code: Shown on the results screen after the shopper submits their email. Leave blank to show no discount.
info.product_quiz_discount_message: Type [code] where the discount code should appear.
info.product_quiz_tag_prefix: The customer gets the tags newsletter, the prefix, and one tag per answer, e.g. quiz-make-toyota. Use them in Shopify Email or Flow.
info.product_quiz_tokens: Type [question_id] to insert that question's answer, e.g. [make].
info.product_quiz_heading_tokens: Use [question_id] to insert an earlier answer, e.g. Which [make] model?
info.image_card_badge_color: Leave blank to use the color scheme’s primary button colors
info.separator_size: Size of the “:” between the numbers, as a percentage of the number size

html_defaults.share_information_about_your: Share information about your brand with your customers. Describe a product, make announcements, or welcome customers to your store.
